prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Try hiding, moving, and chatting with your desktop companion right now.", "Click and drag your pet anywhere on screen, or right-click for quick actions.", "Try Controls Now"]
2: ["Preparing Your Desktop Companion"]
3: ["Build & Preview Your Custom Companion", "Upload photos to generate your custom desktop pet with instant visual feedback.", "Select Companion Photo", "Live Pet Preview"]
4: ["Choose Your Companion Journey", "Pick a ready-to-adopt desktop pet or build a fully custom companion.", "Instant Adoption vs Custom Pet"]
5: ["Welcome Back to Desktop Pet", "Sign in with your account to restore your existing pets and progress.", "Using a different login creates a new profile without your saved pets."]
6: ["Creating Your Unique Companion", "We are generating your desktop pet animations and behaviors.", "Tip: Press Alt+P to summon your pet anywhere on your desktop."]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a name to make the adoption official!", "Pet Name"]
8: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Keep these quick hotkeys in mind to easily control your companion.", "Click & Drag: Move | Right-Click: Options | Alt+H: Hide Pet"]
9: ["Meet Your Desktop Pet in 2 Minutes", "A quick setup to choose, name, and bring your companion to life on your screen.", "Start Setup"]
